## NPSphere 0.65.0

**New**
- **Excel (.xlsx) and LibreOffice (.ods) export**, besides CSV, in **Results** and in the **Satisfaction dashboard**.
  - One file: **Overview** and **Answers** sheets (on the dashboard, one sheet per table).
  - Scores are numbers and dates are dates, ready to sort, filter and chart.
  - The filters on screen apply to every format.
- **Exceptions in the target audience** (internal surveys): "the Finance group, **except** its manager", or "everyone, **except** the IT group".
  - An exception always wins: no survey, no mandatory pop-up, no invitation email.
  - Works for entities (with their children), profiles, groups and users.
- **Change history** in GLPI's own **Historical** tab: survey settings and email templates, questions (added, changed, deleted, reordered) and target audience changes.
- **Rate limiting** on every page that opens without login (public link and email links).
  - Per IP, with the same Symfony RateLimiter GLPI uses for two-factor codes.
  - Invalid links, keys or tokens: 20 in 10 minutes block the IP on all those pages until the window passes. Clearing cookies doesn't reset it.
  - Limits can be changed in `config/local_define.php` (see the README).
- **English translation** (`en_GB`, `en_US`). The plugin follows each user's language in GLPI; the public link and email links follow the browser's language. JavaScript texts are translated too.

**Changed**
- Dates and numbers follow GLPI's **date format** and **number format** preferences, like the rest of GLPI. If you see `2026-10-21` and prefer `21-10-2026`, change the date format in **Setup › General › Default values** (or in each user's preferences).
- Generic texts (Yes, No, Name, Description, Edit…) now use GLPI's own translations.

**Fixed**
- The search box in the answers list showed `{% if is_ticket %}` in its placeholder.

**Install:** extract `npsphere-0.65.0.zip` into GLPI's `marketplace/` (or `plugins/`) folder, then go to **Setup › Plugins** and click **Update**. The update adds one column (`is_excluded`) to the targets table.

Full history (in Portuguese): [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/MichaelRodriguesOficial/NPS-GLPi/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
